function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您需要今天美國黃金的即時價格，建議您參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/XAUUSD:CUR | 提供即時行情、歷史走勢與新聞 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/charts/livegold.html | 以實時圖表呈現金價，並提供市場分析 |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 具備即時報價、技術分析工具與社群討論 |
| 美國商品期貨交易所 (CME) | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metals/gold.html | 官方期貨合約價格與交易資訊 |

如果您想快速查看「今日黃金價格」，可以直接在搜尋引擎輸入「Gold price today」或「XAU/USD」即可得到最新報價。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical price or say we can't fetch. We can mention typical price around $2000 per ounce. But better to say we don't have real-time data.
